explication: k-skill is a collection of 125 skills that let coding agents handle Korean everyday tasks, from public-data lookups to bookings and business research. The main user-to-result flow is an agent selecting a skill, supplying a request, and receiving a result; some skills use the optional HTTP proxy to reach public APIs. The repository also contains standalone packages and deeper analytics tools. The README documents product capabilities, but most skill implementations were not sampled, so the graph keeps their internal call paths unspecified.
